SIX-BOX. (a) PRIOR NUMBERS: hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter 1-8. Best SSIM 0.9278 @ iter-6 (PSNR 28.67). Lever map now COMPLETE, all hr=0: steps FLAT (iter-1 0.8032 vs iter-2 0.8048), capacity +0.010 (iter-3 1024G 0.8145), warm-start +0.039 (iter-4 0.8539), SSIM-loss +0.073 (iter-5 0.9264@0.15), SSIM-weight SATURATED (iter-6 0.9278@0.30 vs iter-5), basis-scale FLAT (iter-7 0.9276@scale0.02), TV-reg FLAT (iter-8 0.9274@tv1e-3). (b) FAILURE MODE: R2-Gaussian is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 128-view breast -- the coarse anisotropic-Gaussian basis (1024 splats, 0.006M params) plateaus at SSIM ~0.928 / PSNR ~28.7 dB, ~7.3 dB BELOW the strong 128-view FBP baseline (PSNR 35.97), so the RMSE/PSNR-gated headroom stays 0. This reproduces the documented ceiling (findings.md 2026-06-03: R2-G structurally bounded on dense-view breast; FBP is already very strong). (c) UNTESTED IN-BUDGET LEVER MOVING hr OFF 0? NONE -- all 7 lever families mapped+exhausted; the strongest (warm-start + SSIM-loss) got closest but still 7.3 dB short. The R2-G paper benchmarks SPARSE-view CBCT (<=50 views) where FBP is weak; on dense 128-view 2D CT it is the wrong inductive bias. (d) DECISION: empty-patch {} re-run of the run-best config to confirm SSIM ~0.928 / hr=0 reproduces (plateau documentation toward HARD iter-20). (e) BUDGET: identical to iter-6, ~660-1000s (node-dependent) << 1080 in-solver wall < 1800 SLURM wall; val figure excluded. (f) val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT. PREDICTION: SSIM ~0.928 (0.925-0.930), hr 0 -- faithful-but-regime-bounded negative result., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
